name: rea-video
title: rea-video
description: Reverse-engineers how a video was made, shot by shot: classifies each shot (live action, AI-generated, 3D, 2D/stop-motion, code render, screen capture and more), detects AI edits and overlay packaging, breaks down the audio, and produces an executable remake plan.
why: REA's sibling for video: the only entry that analyzes and deconstructs existing videos instead of creating new ones — nothing else in the collection reads a finished video's production method.
requires: rea-video CLI (install from the source repo)
adaptations: Translated from Chinese to English: SKILL.md and all eight references/*.md were translated faithfully for the collection's English-only rule; every command, flag, path and JSON field is unchanged from upstream.
